# Cinema subtitles — Style Prompt

> A cinema recap in 16:9: letterboxed footage, a small calligraphic title seal in the top left corner of the black band, and the narration set on a warm ivory paper strip in the bottom band, a rounded card with a gold bookmark tab on its left and a small brick-red diamond seal on its right, dark serif ink and one or two key words in brick red. The strip rises only while the narrator speaks and steps away when the characters' own voices take a beat; their lines then appear as plain white subtitles inside the picture. Short gold calligraphy callouts appear in the top band on the big turns. The vertical sample swaps the letterbox for espresso header and footer bands edged with gold hairlines.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

1. **Two voices, two looks.** Narration lives on the paper strip; original dialogue is white text in the picture with no card. The viewer always knows who is speaking.
2. **The strip is calm.** It fades in once at the start of a narration run, stays put across short pauses while only its words change, and leaves when the original sound owns the beat. No flicker between sentences.
3. **The picture is the film.** The footage is never covered except by the strip in its band; the title seal and callouts sit in the black band, not on faces.
4. **Literary, not loud.** Serif ink on paper, a brush-script title, a gold callout of a few words: the packaging of a well-made drama or documentary recap.

Not a meme edit (no yellow block captions, no emoji, no zoom punches on every word), not a news package (no ticker, no channel bug), not karaoke (no word-by-word colour sweep), not a trailer (no slammed titles, no flashes).

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Footage**: the user's clip (`list_media`) full frame in `.cam` (hard cuts, slow pushes). Scope letterbox bands of 140 px top and bottom (2.39:1 picture) belong to the look; when the clip is already letterboxed, use its own bars. Burned-in subtitles in the clip are hidden by the strip in its band. The example paints three stand-in shots once at half resolution (a woman at a dusk window, a letter in hands, a harbour at night with a ship arriving); the dialogue beat is a punch-in on the first shot.
- **Bottom scrim**: over the last 19 % of the frame, transparent → 8 % at 88 % → 46 % at the bottom (curve ^1.65), so text holds over bright frames.
- **Title seal** (top left, x 36, y 22–24): the title in brush script, 54–60 px, ivory with a 2 px dark stroke and a soft 4 px drop shadow, on a soft dark rounded scrim (52 %), and a small seal pill after it (brick red, a thin gold ring, 20 px heavy white caps: an episode, a part, a year). It fades in at 0.15 s and leaves by about a third of the film; it reprises for the last ~3 s.
- **Paper strip**: 79 % of the frame width, 100 px tall, 46 px above the bottom, centred; ivory paper (`--kertas`), radius 24, a 1.5 px darker paper edge and a soft 12 px shadow 4 px down; a 5 px gold bookmark tab 14 px inside the left edge, from 22 % to 78 % of the height; a brick-red diamond seal (side ≈ 28 px) 22 px inside the right edge with a paler inner diamond. Text: serif 700 at 44 px (46 in the source), dark ink, centred, ≤ 22 characters per line in the source's script, ≈ 40 characters in Latin.
- **Dialogue**: sans 600 at 46 px, ivory with a 3.2 px dark outline and a small shadow, centred inside the picture just above the bottom band (y ≈ 820 at 1080 tall), no card.
- **Callouts**: brush script 50 px, a gold tinted toward ivory, a dark stroke, a small diamond before it and a tapered gold underline, in the top band's right corner (38 px from the edge); at most 8–10 letters.
- **Vertical sample (header bands)**: a 184 px header band and a 188 px footer band in espresso brown (lighter at the outer edge), a warm gold glow behind the header text, 2 px tapered gold hairlines on the picture's edges, a 26 px inner shadow into the picture; the title seal centred in the header band, the paper strip (88 % wide) centred in the footer band, the clip cropped to fill the 1080 × 1548 picture per shot.

## 3. Colour logic

- The cinema furniture is fixed in every brand, like the footage it frames: `--palang` near-black bands, scrims and outlines; `--gading` ivory for the title and dialogue; `--espreso` for the vertical bands; the paper strip's `--kertas`, `--kertas-tepi`, `--tinta` (ink) and `--tinta-sorot` (the brick-red key word).
- The brand enters through the details: `--utama` is the gold bookmark tab, the hairlines, the callout diamonds and underlines, and tints the callout text (`--emas-hias`, 45 % `--utama` in ivory); `--aksen` is the seal diamond and the episode pill (with `--teks-di-aksen`).
- `--latar` is only the stage behind everything (never seen with footage).
- A dark brand keeps the look; a light brand changes only the gold and the seal. The strip never turns dark; dialogue never turns gold.
- The variant **cinema glow** (instead of the strip): narration in warm pale gold with a two-layer soft glow over the bottom scrim, dialogue in pure white, both outlined dark.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` carries the title seal and the callouts: a brush or handwritten script (Caveat 700 in the example; Permanent Marker for a rougher brush). The source uses a running-script CJK brush face.
- The strip uses a serif at 700 (Libre Baskerville in the example; Playfair Display 700 or Cormorant Garamond 700 at +4 px also suit), fixed to the look like the paper.
- `--font-isi` carries dialogue (Inter 600) and the seal pill (Inter 800 caps, tracking 0.06em).
- Sizes at 1920 × 1080: title 60, pill 20, strip 44, dialogue 46, callout 50. In 9:16: strip 38, the rest the same.

## 5. Motion quality

- **Strip**: fades in over 0.18 s at the start of a narration run and out over 0.18 s at its end; its lines swap inside it (in 70 ms, out 56 ms); pauses of ≤ 0.34 s keep the old line until the new one.
- **Dialogue**: in 70 ms, out 56 ms, no card, no motion.
- **Title seal**: fades in over 0.32 s while sliding 10 px from the left; out over 0.32 s; the reprise fades in over 0.32 s and holds to the end.
- **Callouts**: fade 0.24 s while sliding 22 px in from the right; held 1.5–3 s; out 0.24 s.
- **Footage**: hard cuts on the story's beats; slow pushes 1.00 → 1.05 over a shot, or a slow pull-out on the ending (1.08 → 1.00); a punch-in to ~1.4 on a face for an original-dialogue beat.
- **Sound** (when used): a soft whoosh into the first shot and a warm impact on the reveal; never over original dialogue.

## 6. Camera grammar

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Slow push 1.00 → 1.05 | quiet attention, a memory | narration over faces, places, letters |
| Punch-in to ~1.4 on a face, held | the character speaks; the narrator steps aside | original dialogue, a confession, a threat |
| Slow pull-out 1.08 → 1.00 | release, the story lands | endings, reveals, payoffs |
| Detail insert (hands, a letter, an object) | evidence and texture | facts, clues, products |
| Hard cut on the line's end | the next sentence, the next moment | the default |

The bands and the strip never move with the camera.

## 7. Native moves

- **Narration on paper.** The strip rises with the first line, holds across short pauses while the words change, one key word in brick red. *Fits content like:* "Sudah tiga tahun dia menunggu kabar"; a shop's founding story; a documentary recap of a village; a book summary.
- **Voice handover.** The strip fades away and the punched-in character speaks in white inside the picture; the strip comes back with the narrator. *Fits content like:* a drama's key line; a customer's own words in a testimonial; a coach's half-time line; a historical recording.
- **Title seal and reprise.** The brush-script title with an episode pill fades in at the start, leaves, and returns for the ending. *Fits content like:* a series recap; a shop's "Cerita Pelanggan" episodes; a class's chapter title; a podcast clip.
- **Gold calligraphy callout.** A few brushed words in the top band on a turn. *Fits content like:* "Rindu lama", "Titik balik", "Harga gila", "Akhirnya pulang".
- **Brick-red key word.** One or two words per narration line in the strip's red: the time, the number, the turn. *Fits content like:* "tiga tahun", "tak pernah", "Rp50 ribu", "pulang".

## 8. Pitfalls

- **Strip over dialogue.** The strip only shows while the narrator speaks; never keep it on during an original-dialogue beat, and never put dialogue on the paper.
- **Flicker.** Do not fade the strip out and in for a pause under 0.35 s; bridge it.
- **Long lines.** One line per strip; split a long sentence into consecutive lines on its natural pause.
- **Text on faces.** Callouts and the seal stay in the bands; dialogue sits low in the picture, never across eyes.
- **Recolouring the paper or the bars by brand.** The strip is a paper object and the bands are film; only gold and seal follow the brand.
- **Performance**: footage moves by transform on `.cam`; the scrim and bands are static; no animated blur or `backdrop-filter`.
- **Wrong words.** Narration and dialogue from a transcript need checking for names before rendering.

## Measured from the references

From the source's packaging code at 1920 × 1080: strip width 79 %, height 100 px, bottom margin 46 px, radius 24 % of its height, the tab at 22–78 % of the height, text 46 px with 220 px side margins, dialogue outline 3.2 px with a 1.5 px shadow, fades 0.18 s for the strip, 0.32 s for the title seal (shown from 0.15 s to 35 % of the film, reprise in the tail), 0.24 s for callouts with a 22 px slide; scrim 19 % of the height up to 46 % opacity. From its 59 s landscape reference recap: scope bands of ≈ 140 px at 1080, the seal in the top band at the left, callouts in brush script in the top band at the right, the strip filling most of the bottom band, white dialogue just above it.

# Cinema subtitles: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2, medium 3.5, long 5.

## hook

- en: the story's strongest shot, the calligraphic title seal fades in top left, the first narration line lands on the paper strip
- id: gambar terkuat cerita, cap judul kaligrafi muncul pelan di kiri atas, kalimat narasi pertama mendarat di kartu kertas

## problem

- en: the trouble in one shot; the narration swaps on the same strip with the turning word in brick red, a gold calligraphy callout top right
- id: masalahnya dalam satu gambar; narasi berganti di kartu yang sama, kata kuncinya merah bata, teks hias kaligrafi emas di kanan atas

## fact

- en: a detail shot (a letter, a sign, a date) pushed in slowly; the fact narrated on the strip, its figure or name in brick red
- id: gambar detail (surat, papan, tanggal) didorong pelan; faktanya dinarasikan di kartu, angka atau namanya merah bata

## step

- en: a run of hard cuts, one line per cut on the strip that stays put across short pauses, so only the words change
- id: rangkaian potongan keras, satu kalimat per potong di kartu yang tetap diam melintasi jeda pendek, hanya katanya yang berganti

## compare

- en: two shots cut back and forth, the strip naming each side; the callout top right names the difference in calligraphy
- id: dua gambar dipotong bolak-balik, kartu menyebut tiap sisi; teks hias kaligrafi di kanan atas menyebut perbedaannya

## number

- en: the figure as the strip's brick-red word over a held shot; the callout repeats it in gold calligraphy, at most 8-10 characters
- id: angkanya jadi kata merah bata di kartu di atas gambar yang ditahan; teks hias emas mengulanginya, paling banyak 8-10 huruf

## proof

- en: the original voice owns the beat: the strip fades away, a punch-in on the speaker, their line in white inside the picture
- id: suara asli memegang ketukan: kartu kertas hilang, kamera mendekat ke pembicara, kalimatnya putih di dalam gambar

## offer

- en: the product or place in a clean wide shot, the strip names it with the price in brick red, the callout gives the deal
- id: produk atau tempatnya dalam gambar lebar yang bersih, kartu menyebutnya dengan harga merah bata, teks hias memberi penawarannya

## cta

- en: the title seal returns top left, the strip carries what to do and where, held 2-3 s on a calm shot
- id: cap judul kembali di kiri atas, kartu kertas berisi ajakan dan tempatnya, diam 2-3 dtk di gambar yang tenang

## payoff

- en: the resolving shot pushed out slowly, the strip returns with the closing line, the title seal reprises; held 3 s
- id: gambar penyelesaian ditarik mundur pelan, kartu kembali dengan kalimat penutup, cap judul muncul lagi; diam 3 dtk

<!doctype html>
<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1920, height=1080" />
    <title>Subtitle sinema</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Caveat"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 700; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Libre Baskerville"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 700; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Inter"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 600; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Inter"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 800; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. */
      :root {
        --latar: #0a0a0c; --latar-2: #17130f; --utama: #c69442; --aksen: #b84a2c;
        --teks: #faf4e8; --teks-redup: #b9b1a4; --teks-di-utama: #17130f; --teks-di-aksen: #fcf6ec;
        --utama-di-latar: #f5e0a8; --aksen-di-latar: #e0805c;
        --font-judul: "Caveat", "Noto Sans", cursive; --font-isi: "Inter", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
        /* Milik gaya ini: kertas gading untuk narasi (benda kertas, tidak ikut brand), tinta, kata kunci merah bata. */
        --kertas: #f2ede7; --kertas-tepi: #cec4b6; --tinta: #1e1916; --tinta-sorot: #b8431e;
        /* Perlengkapan bioskop tetap gelap di semua brand (pita 2,39:1 milik rekaman): pita, gading cap judul dan dialog, emas teks hias diwarnai brand. */
        --palang: #050506; --gading: #faf4e8; --emas-hias: color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 45%, var(--gading));
        /* Rekaman pengganti (jendela senja, surat, pelabuhan malam): tetap di semua brand. */
        --f-dinding: #1d2b2e; --f-dinding2: #0e1416; --f-senja: #f0a060; --f-senja2: #f6d5a0; --f-laut: #3d5a6e; --f-gelap: #08090b;
        --f-kulit: #d9a07c; --f-rambut: #1a1210; --f-kain: #7a3b34; --f-kertas: #efe2c8; --f-tinta: #4a3a30; --f-malam: #0f1a2e; --f-malam2: #24345a;
        --f-lampu: #ffc070; --f-kapal: #11151c;
      }
      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
      html, body { width: 1920px; height: 1080px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }
      #root { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); color: var(--teks); font-family: var(--font-isi); }
      .scene, .full { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 1920px; height: 1080px; }
      .scene { visibility: hidden; } #s1 { visibility: visible; }
      .cam { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 1920px; height: 1080px; }
      .cam img { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 1920px; height: 1080px; visibility: hidden; }
      /* Rekaman bioskop: pita gelap 140 px atas dan bawah (2,39:1), garis gelap lembut 19% bawah agar teks tetap terbaca. */
      .palang { position: absolute; left: 0; width: 1920px; height: 140px; background: var(--palang); }
      #scrim { background: linear-gradient(transparent 81%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--palang) 8%, transparent) 88%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--palang) 46%, transparent)); }
      /* Cap judul kaligrafi kiri atas: alas gelap lembut, judul tulisan tangan bergaris, cap merah kecil di sampingnya. */
      #cap { position: absolute; left: 36px; top: 22px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; padding: 18px 34px 20px; border-radius: 24px; visibility: hidden;
        background: radial-gradient(closest-side, color-mix(in oklab, var(--palang) 52%, transparent) 60%, transparent); }
      #cap .j { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 700; font-size: 60px; line-height: 64px; color: var(--gading); white-space: nowrap;
        -webkit-text-stroke: 4px var(--palang); paint-order: stroke fill; text-shadow: 0 4px 5px color-mix(in oklab, var(--palang) 70%, transparent); }
      #cap .b { padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 800; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; background: var(--aksen); color: var(--teks-di-aksen);
        box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 82%, transparent); }
      /* Kartu kertas narasi: gading membulat, bilah emas tegak di kiri, cap belah ketupat merah di kanan; hanya selama narator bicara. */
      #kertas { position: absolute; left: 202px; top: 934px; width: 1517px; height: 100px; border-radius: 24px; visibility: hidden;
        background: var(--kertas); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.5px var(--kertas-tepi), 0 4px 12px color-mix(in oklab, var(--palang) 50%, transparent); }
      #kertas::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 14px; top: 22px; width: 5px; height: 56px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--utama); }
      .seal { position: absolute; right: 8px; top: 36px; width: 28px; height: 28px; transform: rotate(45deg) scale(0.707); background: var(--aksen); }
      .seal i { position: absolute; left: 7px; top: 7px; width: 14px; height: 14px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--kertas) 75%, var(--utama)); }
      .nar { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; line-height: 100px; text-align: center; opacity: 0;
        font-family: "Libre Baskerville", serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 44px; color: var(--tinta); white-space: nowrap; }
      .nar b { color: var(--tinta-sorot); }
      /* Dialog asli (bukan narasi): teks putih bergaris gelap di dalam gambar, tanpa kartu. */
      .dlg { position: absolute; left: 0; width: 1920px; top: 820px; text-align: center; font-weight: 600; font-size: 46px; color: var(--gading); white-space: nowrap; opacity: 0;
        -webkit-text-stroke: 6.4px var(--palang); paint-order: stroke fill; text-shadow: 0 2px 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--palang) 60%, transparent); }
      /* Teks hias kaligrafi emas di pita atas kanan. */
      .co { position: absolute; right: 38px; top: 30px; padding: 14px 26px 16px 48px; white-space: nowrap; visibility: hidden;
        background: radial-gradient(closest-side, color-mix(in oklab, var(--palang) 42%, transparent) 60%, transparent); }
      .co .t { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 700; font-size: 50px; line-height: 56px; color: var(--emas-hias);
        -webkit-text-stroke: 4.4px var(--palang); paint-order: stroke fill; }
      .co::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 26px; top: 38px; width: 12px; height: 12px; transform: rotate(45deg); background: var(--utama); }
      .co .u { height: 3px; margin: 2px 0 0 -22px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--utama), color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 20%, transparent)); }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1920" data-height="1080" data-fps="30">
      <!-- Footage pengguna: klip upl_… dari list_media di dalam .cam (yang digerakkan tetap .cam). Di sini tiga gambar dilukis sekali
           dari PRNG berbiji sebagai pengganti; pita 2,39:1 milik gaya ini, bukan rekaman. -->
      <div class="full"><div class="cam" id="cam"></div></div>
      <div class="full" id="scrim"></div>
      <div class="palang" style="top: 0"></div><div class="palang" style="top: 940px"></div>
      <div class="scene" id="s1" data-role="hook"><!-- Adegan 1, pembuka: jendela senja, cap judul kaligrafi masuk pelan di kiri atas, kartu kertas narasi muncul di bawah. --></div>
      <div class="scene" id="s2" data-role="problem"><!-- Adegan 2, masalah: surat di tangan, narasi berganti di kartu yang sama (jeda pendek dijembatani), teks hias emas di kanan atas. -->
        <div class="co" id="co1"><div class="t">Rindu lama</div><div class="u"></div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="scene" id="s3" data-role="proof"><!-- Adegan 3, bukti: dialog asli memegang ketukan ini, kartu kertas hilang, kalimat tokoh putih di dalam gambar. --></div>
      <div class="scene" id="s4" data-role="payoff"><!-- Adegan 4, akhir: pelabuhan malam, kartu kertas kembali dengan kalimat penutup, cap judul muncul lagi, diam sampai akhir. --></div>
      <div id="cap"><span class="j">Surat dari Pelabuhan</span><span class="b">EPS 3</span></div>
      <div id="kertas"><i class="seal"><i></i></i>
        <div class="nar">Sudah <b>tiga tahun</b> dia menunggu kabar.</div>
        <div class="nar">Surat terakhirnya <b>tak pernah</b> dibalas.</div>
        <div class="nar">Malam ini, kapal itu <b>pulang.</b></div>
      </div>
      <div class="dlg">“Kamu masih menunggunya?”</div>
      <div class="dlg">“Dia pasti pulang.”</div>
    </div>
    <script>
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      const $ = (s) => document.querySelector(s), $$ = (s) => [...document.querySelectorAll(s)];
      const W = 1920, H = 1080, END = 15;
      let seed = 9; // PRNG berbiji (mulberry32): lukisan sama persis di pratinjau dan render
      const rnd = () => { seed = (seed + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0; let t = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed); t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t; return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296; };
      const css = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement), C = {};
      for (const n of "dinding dinding2 senja senja2 laut gelap kulit rambut kain kertas tinta malam malam2 lampu kapal".split(" ")) {
        const h = css.getPropertyValue("--f-" + n).trim(); C[n] = [1, 3, 5].map((i) => parseInt(h.slice(i, i + 2), 16)); }
      const rgb = (c, a = 1) => `rgba(${c.map(Math.round)},${a})`, mx = (a, b, t) => a.map((v, i) => v + (b[i] - v) * t);
      // ===== Lukisan pengganti rekaman (sekali saat dimuat, setengah resolusi: lembut seperti film) =====
      const K = 0.5, cv = () => { const c = Object.assign(document.createElement("canvas"), { width: W * K, height: H * K }), g = c.getContext("2d"); g.scale(K, K); return [c, g]; };
      const lin = (g, x0, y0, x1, y1, st) => { const G = g.createLinearGradient(x0, y0, x1, y1); st.forEach(([o, c, a]) => G.addColorStop(o, rgb(c, a ?? 1))); return G; };
      const glow = (g, x, y, r, c, a) => { const G = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); G.addColorStop(0, rgb(c, a)); G.addColorStop(1, rgb(c, 0)); g.fillStyle = G; g.fillRect(x - r, y - r, 2 * r, 2 * r); };
      const box = (g, f, x, y, w, h) => { g.fillStyle = f; g.fillRect(x, y, w, h); };
      const ell = (g, f, x, y, rx, ry, r = 0) => { g.fillStyle = f; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y, rx, ry, r, 0, 7); g.fill(); };
      const path = (g, f, d) => { g.fillStyle = f; g.fill(new Path2D(d)); };
      function jendela(g) { // kamar gelap kehijauan, jendela senja di kanan, perempuan menghadap jendela, cahaya tepi hangat
        box(g, lin(g, 0, 0, W, 0, [[0, C.dinding2], [0.6, C.dinding], [1, C.dinding2]]), 0, 0, W, H);
        box(g, lin(g, 0, 160, 0, 820, [[0, C.senja2], [0.55, C.senja], [0.62, C.laut], [1, mx(C.laut, C.gelap, 0.5)]]), 1060, 160, 640, 660);
        glow(g, 1380, 520, 520, C.senja, 0.45);
        for (const x of [1060, 1370, 1690]) box(g, rgb(C.gelap), x - 10, 150, 20, 680); box(g, rgb(C.gelap), 1050, 480, 660, 16);
        path(g, rgb(C.kain, 0.9), "M980 120 C1040 400 1000 700 1050 960 L900 960 C930 700 900 400 960 120 Z");
